title: Grandparents and where J. C. got his name
summary: The grandparents were Charlotte and Jesse; his father was Charles Brannon.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers

blocks.x: Do you recall your grand parents?
Well, I can give you their names. My grandmother's name was Charlotte and my grandfather's name was Jesse.
Yes. That's the one, he was named after instead of being named Jesse, named him J. C. ... (something about Jesus Christ, too many talking at once) grandfather
So he was named after your grandfather Jesse, where does the C. come from? What was that for?
I can't go no father than that.
I know because the twin brother was C. B. after ...
My father, Charles Brannon (?), that was my father's name.
What was the ... do you have any white, or Indian or whatever it may be?
She just explained that to him I think before you arrived.
OK. How far back did your folks, what was some of the things they expressed to you?

Can I go father back on my mother's side? I can only go back as far as my grandfather, Grandpa Jesse, but I think I could go a little bit father back on my mother's side. I don't think you want that, do you?
She was a Lilly before she married a Higginbotham ... ... (too many others talking) : ... His name was Robert ... do you remember his father's name? ...
? : ... give her stepmother credit for that because in those days not too many people that far back even went to high school.
